historical_control_caveat: Luna baseline combines 38 historical Codex CLI 0.154.0/concurrency-4 trials with one local CLI 0.160.0 trial. Local hints used up to 3 concurrent trials before the user scheduling amendment and up to 6 sharing 8 Docker CPUs afterward. Task, instruction and grading hashes match, but client version, run date, concurrency and resource policy differ: this is a descriptive historical-control comparison, not an isolated causal hint effect.
execution_resource_caveat: User-authorized scheduling amendment after block 131: earlier local observations used one block/up to 3 trials with unrestricted Docker CPU affinity. Later observations run up to 2 blocks/up to 6 trials, with all main containers and network sidecars sharing Docker CPUs 0-7 of 12. No model, effort, task, prompt, grading, agent timeout or verifier timeout changed. Resource contention can affect completion and cost, so retain execution-cohort labels.

account_usage.observation: Account-wide usage; not the sweep alone.
